attributes.description:
Controls the height of slider tracks (the horizontal bar that represents the slider range). This determines the vertical size of the track. Acceptable units: px.
CSS variable: --wm-slider-track-height

Controls the border radius (rounded corners) of slider tracks. This determines how rounded the corners of the track appear. Acceptable units: px.
CSS variable: --wm-slider-track-border-radius

Sets the background color of slider filled tracks (the portion of the track from the start to the current value). This determines what color the filled track appears in.
CSS variable: --wm-slider-track-filled-background

Sets the background color of slider unfilled tracks (the portion of the track from the current value to the end). This determines what color the unfilled track appears in, typically matching the primary container theme color.
CSS variable: --wm-slider-track-unfilled-background

Sets the background color of slider handle (the draggable handle that users interact with to set values). This determines what color the handle appears in.
CSS variable: --wm-slider-handle-background

Controls the height of slider handles. This determines the vertical size of the handle. Acceptable units: px.
CSS variable: --wm-slider-handle-height

Controls the width of slider handles. This determines the horizontal size of the handle. Acceptable units: px.
CSS variable: --wm-slider-handle-width

Controls the border radius (rounded corners) of slider handles. This determines how rounded the corners of the handle appear. Acceptable units: px.
CSS variable: --wm-slider-handle-border-radius

Controls the visual spacing between slider handles and the filled/unfilled track segments. Acceptable units: px.
CSS variable: --wm-slider-handle-gap

Sets the text color of labels (text elements that describe or identify other content). This determines what color the label text appears in, which should contrast well with the background for readability.
CSS variable: --wm-slider-range-label-color

Controls the internal spacing inside labels (the space between the label text and its border). This creates breathing room around the label content.
CSS variable: --wm-slider-range-label-padding

Controls how large label text appears (text that describes or identifies other content). Larger values make labels more prominent, smaller values make them more subtle.
CSS variable: --wm-slider-range-label-font-size

Controls how thick or bold label text appears. 'normal' makes it regular weight, 'bold' makes it thicker, and numbers (100-900) provide fine control over thickness.
CSS variable: --wm-slider-range-label-font-weight

Sets the typeface (font style) for label text. This determines whether the label text appears in Arial, Times New Roman, or other font styles.
CSS variable: --wm-slider-range-label-font-family

Sets the background color of labels (the area behind the label text). When set to 'none', labels have no background color, making them transparent.
CSS variable: --wm-slider-range-label-background-color

Controls the visual spacing between slider and the label segments. Acceptable units: px.
CSS variable: --wm-slider-range-label-gap
